perf.method: 42 interleaved rounds — a whole multiple of the seven variants, so the rotation gives every variant each starting position equally often; each round spawns every variant once as `node <fixture> greet ada`, after one discarded warm-up round. Every parsing variant's package is resolved against the range `benchmarks/package.json` declares before any timing, and its version and resolved path are on every row. Absolute ms are a property of the machine recorded above and are not comparable across machines; the banded number is the paired ratio.

records.note: the floor: Node starting and writing one line, no parser
spawned `node commander.mjs greet ada`; 13.9 ms of this is above the bare-node floor
spawned `node burgee-commander.mjs greet ada`; 27.8 ms of this is above the bare-node floor
spawned `node yargs.mjs greet ada`; 76.98 ms of this is above the bare-node floor
spawned `node burgee-yargs.mjs greet ada`; 62.15 ms of this is above the bare-node floor
spawned `node cac.mjs greet ada`; 3.18 ms of this is above the bare-node floor
spawned `node burgee.mjs greet ada`; 29.02 ms of this is above the bare-node floor

gate.why: the front-end must not cost meaningfully more to start than the package it replaces; a ceiling, not a promise — the measured value is what the band watches

records.note: median of 42 paired spawns, each round's burgee/commander against the same round's commander
